tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// mnyam med jo bo chen po nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i skor bzhugs so// ༄༅// sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin

dmar po ni// bskal pa'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis mda' gzhu g.yas 'og mas rdo rje dbyug to dkar po 'dzin pa'i mchog /g.yon 'og ma rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub can// spyan gsum pa g.yon brkyang stabs kyis bzhugs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes bya ba ni rtsa rgyud le'u gsum las rab 'byams kyi le'u las so/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar las/ khyi gdong can gyi rdo rje lha mo mkha' 'gro ma rigs bzhi/ yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma lha zhal gyis 'khyud pa/ bsgoms na gdug pa kun 'dul ba'i// gzi brjid mthu stobs rta mchog dpal nyid dang mtshungs par 'gyur// yang na nag po dang dbus dmar po dang g.yon/ dkar po'o/ /phyag g.yas gsum rdo rje dang dbyug to dang bcas pa ral gri'o/ /g.yon gsum thod pa zhags pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal ba/ thal mor bcas pa'o// sprul pa mkha' lding rgyal po mang po rnam par spro ba'o// phyag g.yon pa g.yas/ dbyug to 'dzin par byas nas/ zhabs gnyis g.yas kyis klu rgyal/ nor rgyas dang g.yon tshangs pa bcas pa gnon cing*/ gzir ba// bsgoms na sbrul gyis zin pa sogs kyi dug rnams skyod pa dang*// sna tshogs las rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes dang oṃ ha ya grī ba hrīḥ a haṃ a haṃ aṃ aṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ /khro bo rta mgrin gyi'o// zhes pa ni phyi ma'i rgyud las so// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ha ya grī ba sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// don bdag med la gnod pa'i bya ba rnams spangs nas// rang nyid brten pa'i gnas ni dben pa'i phyogs song nas// gnas der bsam gtan khang pa shin tu yid 'thad pa// 'og gi sa gzhi rab tu 'thas par brdungs pa la// sa la ma lhung ba'i lci dri bzang rnams dang ni// bsres la legs par byugs la gzugs brnyan 'char bar bya// de nas dri zhim me tog gtor la rgyan rnams bkram// dkyil 'khor dag tu zhugs shing dam tshig ldan pa yi// yang na so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la gnas sems// bskyed pas bde ba'i stan la gnas pa'i skad cig las// rta mgrin bla ma la ni bdun po yang dag bya// de rjes tshad med bzhi yis bdag blo legs par sbyang*// shū n+ya tā yi sngags kyis stong pa nyid du bsgom// bdag nyid rnam par shes pa pam̐ du blta bar bya// pam̐ de yongs su gyur las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad// pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te// ma las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de yi steng du bsam// de yi steng du hūm̐ bsam hūm̐ las rdo rjer gyur// de yi lte ba la ni hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam// de las 'od zer rab 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*// rwa ba gur du gyur bsam rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas gzhal yas khang du bskyed// de yi nang du rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa las// bdag nyid khro bo rta mgrin gyi ni skur gyur te// dmar po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa// dbus dmar g.yas sngo g.yon dkar ba// dbus ma'i gtsug na rta mgo ljang gu phyung*// gyen du kha bltas rta skad 'byin// g.yas dang g.yon gyi dang pos ni// rdo rje pad+ma bsnams pa'o// mtha' ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs// rigs lnga'i bdag nyid dbu la'o// dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes// thod pa'i phreng bas rab tu brgyan// yan lag gdug pa'i sbrul gyis brgyan// sku smad stag gi pags pas g.yogs// zhabs bzhi yis ni 'jig rten gyi// lha chen bzhi ni rab tu mnan// me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs// dkyil 'khor gyi ni phyogs bzhir ni// shar du rdo rje las byed ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sngon mor bsgom// lho ru gshin rje las byed ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis nag mor bsgom// nub tu klu yi las byed ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis dkar mor bsgom// byang du gnod sbyin las byed ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis ljang gur bsgom// g.yas pa kun na gri gug ste// g.yon pa kun na thod khrag 'dzin// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rdzogs nas ni// ye shes sems dpa' bkug la gzhug /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlha yi 'khor lo bsgoms nas ni// las rnams 'dod don bzlas pa bya// oṃ ha ha/ hi hi/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hrīḥhrīḥ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ bsnyen pa grangs bzhin bzlas nas ni// las byed rnams kyi mtshan sngags bzla// badz+ra shwa na sa ma ya/ ya ma shwa na sa ma ya/ nā ga shā na sa ma ya/ kha raka shwa na sa ma ya/ gtso 'khor las la sbyor ba'i sngags// rgyal 'gong rgyal zhes dpe gcig la snang*/ po'i tshe la ma sha doṃ/ ro la khrag 'thung*/ snying khrag badz+ra sā dhu sa ma ya dzaḥ badz+ra dzi tra ka rog ta 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ snying khrag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

badz+ra aṅku sha dza dzaḥ 'byung po'i tshe la ma shad doṃ/ ro la khrag 'thung*/ snying khrag 'byung po 'byung mo pra ti pra mo/ tshe la ma sha doṃ/ ro la khrag 'thung*/ snying khrag mya la la/ sbos sbos/ bh+yo bh+yo/ kroṃ kroṃ sa na/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ta ki tsa ti byi tsa ti/ hū ya hū ya/ hu lu hu lu/ su ru te su ru te swā hā hūm̐ phaṭa/ rtsa ba'i sngags dang snying po dang*// nye ba'i snying po las kyi sngags// ji lta ba yi rim pa ni// bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya// nya sha sgog btsong spangs pa yi// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen po// lnga'am yang na gnyis gnyis gtang*// ji ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab// dge ba bla med byang chub rgya chen bsngo// dpal rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs rdzogs so// rgya rgya// rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal mar med mdzad kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// bod kyi lo tsā ba bhik+ṣu shī la dzi tas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// ༈ /na mo kro dha rā dzā ya/ ches zab mchog tu rmad byung ba// rta mchog dpal gyi sgrub thabs 'di// mdo tsam bdag gis bshad bya yi// yid la dga' ba bskyed de nyon// maṇ+ḍal dmar po legs par brgyan la tshom bu lnga bkram/ mchod pa dang gtor ma gsum bsham/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma/ de la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang rta mgrin sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba ltar yan lag bdun pa bya/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi// zhes brjod/ yang na skyabs sems gong du ma byas par skabs 'dir byas kyang rung*/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/

a las zla ba/ mam̐ las nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i srung 'khor dang*/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i dbus su rang sems rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rang nyid khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing*/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum dbus ma'i steng du rta mgo ljang zhur gyen du bltas te rta skad 'byin pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang pad+ma/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ zhabs bzhi g.yon brkyangs pa'i brkyang bskum dang gar stabs kyis tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang po ma hā de wa rnams mnan pa/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ stag lpags sbrul rgyan mi mgo'i do shal can/ khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar du rdo rje las byed ma mthing skya/ lhor gshin rje las byed ma mthing nag nub tu klu mo las byed ma dkar mo/ byang du gnod sbyin las byed ma ljang gu/ thams cad kyang khyi gdong zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa spyi dang mthun par bsgoms la/ oṃ ha ha hi hi hriṃ hriṃ hrīḥhrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces rtsa ba'i sngags ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ badz+ra shwa na sa ma ya/ ya ma shwa na sa ma ya/ nā ga shwa na sa ma ya/ kha raka shwa na sa ma ya/ zhes btags pa bzla zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ oṃ ta kri ta tsa ti bi tsa ti/ hu ya hu ya/ hu lu hu lu/ su ru te su ru te swā hā/ zhes pa sku dang gsung dang thugs kyis sngags sam/ rtsa sngags dang snying po nye ba'i snying po ste/ de dag kyang ci 'grub bzla'o// las sngags ni sgrub thabs rnams su shes par bya'o// thun bsdu bar 'dod na/

rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ dmar po las gtso 'khor lnga spros mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ hūm̐/ chags med sogs kyi bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni nas/ shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlab/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya ba'am gang 'grub bya'o// bar 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya zhing*/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ gtso bo'i gtor snod bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i pad gzhong yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ de'i nang du bcud yi ge 'bru gsum las byung ba'i lha'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar du gyur/ las byed ma bzhi'i gtor ma/ a las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod kyi nang du 'bru gsum las byung ba'i lha'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar du gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug gtor ma'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas zag med bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlab/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pas phul/ slar yang mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang*/ khyed kyis sems can sogs/ badz+ra muḥzhes ye shes pa gshegs/

dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang bkra shis sogs bya'o// rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis dge ba bsngos nas thun mtshams la 'jug mchod gtor lhag ma rnams gtsang sar dor ro// 'di'i rjes gnang yang*/ rta mgrin lhan skyes kyi de nyid 'don pa spos pas rung ba las tshom bu lnga dgod/ phyag mtshan rdo rje dang pad+ma nyid dgod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang skabs/ shes rab stong nyid rdo rje dang*// snying rje ma chags pad+ma dmar// thabs dang thabs byung zung du 'jug /ye shes thugs kyi dbang thob shog /ces brjod pa nyid khyad par ro// sgrub thabs kun la zab bo zhes// grags pa'i dga' bas yongs khyab pa// shwa na bzhi bskor sgom pa'i thabs// snying po tsam zhig bkod 'di mtshar// ces pa 'di dpal rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor du grags pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyis le'u mtshan no// ༈ /rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor gyi rjes gnang dbang gi tshul du bskur ba'i cho ga gdon bgegs mthar byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ 'di'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben zhing yid dang mthun par maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad re khā dkar po bri/ gru chad bzhi phyogs mdog tu btang ba'i lte bar nyi gdan la tshon phung dmar po/ shar sogs phyogs bzhir tshon phung mthing skya/ mthing nag dkar po/ ljang gu rnams bkod par mañdzi'i khar bum pa lnga tshan lnga'i bcud ldan mgul chings dmar po gzungs rdor bcas/ de'i mdun du dbang gtor dmar po dar dmar gdugs can/ g.yas g.yon du rdo rje dang pad+ma/ mtha' skor chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ 'bul gtor gnyis/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu 'thor nas las bum sogs nyer bsdogs bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon stan bde bar 'dug ste sngon 'gro gtor mar chab bran/

a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum gyis byin brlabs te/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas mgron bkug nas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐ brgya rtsa sogs kyis bsngos la/ ye dharmā dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// zhes chos bshad/ bgegs dang log 'dren rnams/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo khro mo rnams kyi= khyad par du yi dam khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ 'dir dbang bskur ba'i cho ga sgrub par byed pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi rdo rje me 'bar bas khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs brjod pas bskrad la/ rak+ṣa srung 'khor bsgom/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs kyis byin phab nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das=

dam pa'i chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes nyer gcig sogs kyis skyabs 'gro dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du dpal rta mgrin gyi sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes sems bskyed/ rang gi snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma/ de la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang rta mgrin sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ gu ru kro dha rā dza ba ra ha ya la li ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// sogs nas/ thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// zhes pa'i bar bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya// rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan du 'bul bar gyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// zhes lus 'bul/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ mam̐ las nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i srung 'khor dang*/ rdo rje dang hūm̐ dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i dbus su rang sems rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing*/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum dbus ma'i steng du rta mgo ljang zhur gyen du ltas te rta skad 'byin pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang pad+ma/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yon brkyangs pa'i brkyang bskum dang gar stabs kyis tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang po ma hā de ba rnams mnan pa/

rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ stag lpags sbrul rgyan mi mgo'i do shal can/ khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar du rdo rje las byed ma mthing skya/ lhor gshin rjes las byed ma mthing nag nub tu klu mo las byed ma dkar mo/ byang du gnod sbyin las byed ma ljang gu/ thams cad kyang khyi gdong zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa spyi dang mthun par bsgoms la/ oṃ ha ha hi hi hriṃ hriṃ hriḥhriḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces rtsa ba'i sngags ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ badz+ra shwa na sa ma ya/ ya ma shwa na sa ma ya/ nā ga shwa na sa ma ya/ kha ra ka shwa na sa ma ya/ zhes btags pa bzla zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ ta kri ta tsa ti bi tsa ti/ hu ya hu ya/ hu lu hu lu/ su ra te su ra te swā hā/ zhes pa sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi sngags sam/ rtsa sngags dang snying po dang nye ba'i snying po ste/ de dag kyang ci 'grub bzla'o// las sngags ni sgrub thabs rnams su shes par bya'o// thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ dmar po las gtso 'khor lnga spros mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ hūm̐/ sku mdog chags med nub ka'i dmar thag 'dra// 'bar ba'i dbu la ral pa gyen du brdzes// ma rig tshangs pa kha bub gnon pa'i lha// pad+ma rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes ha ya grī ba rta mchog dpal// zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭa 'brug stong de ri ri// zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs pa'i tshems nang na// gdug pa 'dul ba'i me stag phrom phrom 'bar// khro rgyal dbang gi rta skad tsher tsher 'tsher// rta mgrin rta skad 'tsher la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// nas shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas mchod bstod gong bzhin bya ba'am gang 'grub bya'o// bar 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mthar/ bdag la dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol lo// de nas mdun bskyed shū n+ya tās sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal dang bum pa gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥnas/ gtso bos dbu brgyan bar gong bdag bskyed bzhin/ dbang rdzas kyi gtor ma dang*/ phyag mtshan skad cig gis rta mgrin zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ de nas mchod pa kha gsos la gong ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du re re bzhin sbyar bas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐/ sku mchog chags med sogs kyis bstod/ dbang rdzas kyi rta mgrin zhu ba las gtor ma dang rdo rje pad+ma gyur/ gzungs thag bzung zhing sngags bzlas pas/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po bdud rtsir spyan drangs/

bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar thim/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying rnams brgya rtsa la sogs pa gang 'grub dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gtor ma phyag mtshan rnams la dmigs nas nyer gcig re bzla/ las bum la'ang sngags bzla/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ gtso bo'i gtor snod bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i pad gzhong yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ de'i nang du bcud yi ge 'bru gsum las byung ba'i lha'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar du gyur/ las byed ma bzhi'i gtor ma/ a las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod kyi nang du 'bru gsum las byung ba'i lha'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar du gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug gtor ma'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlab/ rtsa sngags dang 'khor bzhi'i sngags mtha' i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa lan gsum res phul/ slar yang mchod cing bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ dung chos kyi chu bum par blugs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bum nang gi lha ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar gyur par bsam/ de nas slob ma rnams badz+ra kro dha bzla bzhin pas las bum gyi chus khrus byed du gzhug de nas sems bskyed gsal gdab sogs ji ltar rigs pas mtshams sbyar/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba ni/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar/ 'gro ba mtha' yas pa'i mgon skyabs/ gnas chen po brgyad kyis bdag po/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga bcu rtsa gnyis kyi gtsug gi nor bu/ chos rgyal drug cu rtsa bzhis mnga' gsol ba'i bla ma/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mkhan po/ mdo sde 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa'i bshes gnyen/

mngon pa 'dzin pa mtha' yas pa'i bkur gnas/ rig pa 'dzin pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i slob dpon/ mdor na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti sha de nyid skar shākya dbang phyug gis spyan drangs nas khri khar bzhugs/ de'i tshe sngon mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi chos blon bran ka dpal gyi yon tan bya ba de glang dar mas mer bsregs pas kho rang gi mnes bos pa'i rkyen byas gnod sbyin ma rungs par gyur nas bod khams mtha' dbus kun tu gnod pa byas skabs der/ rje jo bo chen po la'ang tho btsams pas bzhugs khri'i steng nas sku brul ba byung ba na/ de 'dul ba'i phyir du rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor mdzad/ gnod sbyin de btul nas sgrub thabs kyang mdzad pa la brten jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes te bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs su bzhed mod/ phyis rje btsun sgrol ba'i mgon pos gsar 'gyur sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las kyang gsal bar bstan pa'i bla med ma rgyud rta'i rgyal po'i rigs kyi rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor te/ de dag gi bka' srol las byon pa'i rjes gnang dbang gi tshul du 'bul bar byed pa las slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi rten gnyis ka bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mchog rol par gsal ba la byin rlabs kyi chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal phul/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i phyir du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal rta mgrin yi dam du 'tshal gyi/

bdag la byin gyis brlab pa stsal du gsol/ ces lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs pa legs shing bzlas brjod la brtson par gyis shig ces spro ba bskyed/ de nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rta mchog rol pa gtso 'khor lnga la skyabs yul thams cad kyis bskor ba mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar thog mar bsag sbyong spel gsum gyi gnad bsdus pa yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ji snyed su dag sogs/ de nas brgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs/ de nas sngags kyi lam la spro ba bskyed pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin gyi// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// gang dag de bzhin ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag gis ni gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa mnyam med brnyes// skyob pa sangs rgyas he ru kas// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces sngags kyi che ba brjod/ bar chad bsal ba'i slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro bo rta mgrin gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te bgegs rnams rgyang ring du bskrad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha sogs brjod cing las bum gyis chab gtor zhing*/ sngon chad dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du ma zhugs pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug sngon po res gdong bcings pa'i mos pa mdzod/

oṃ tsak+ṣu r+bhan+dha wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag rten gyi slad du me tog gi phreng ba re'ang byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gtad/ de nas khyed rang rnams rdo rje slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi shar du khrid par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sa ma ya hūm̐/ de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bzhag ste/ sa ma ya a zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba re re'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa re res rgyas btab par mos te bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ de brtan par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa snying gar bzhag ste/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la dkyil 'khor pa la gsol ba gdab pa ni slob dpon gyis bgyi bar gda' ste/ dril gsil dang bcas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces brjod/ de nas slob ma las bum gyi chu dang*/ kro dhas bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ mam̐ las nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i srung 'khor dang*/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i dbus su khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/

khyed rang rnams khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing*/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum dbus ma'i steng du rta mgo ljang zhur gyen du bltas te rta skad 'byin pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang pad+ma/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yon brkyangs pa'i brkyang bskum dang gar stabs kyis tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang po ma hā de ba rnams mnan pa/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ stag lpags sbrul rgyan mi mgo'i do shal can/ khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// shar du rdo rje las byed ma mthing skya/ lhor gshin rje las byed ma mthing nag nub tu klu mo las byed ma dkar mo/ byang du gnod sbyin las byed ma ljang gu/ thams cad kyang khyi gdong zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'i skur lam gyis gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ rnams gsal thob mdzod/ slar yang khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bla ma rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag bzhi par gsal ba dang*/ snying gi nang du yang hūm̐ḥyig mar me lta bur gsal btab/ spyi bo'i bla ma rta mgrin gyi gnas gsum las 'od zer 'bar ba dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus gang*/ sdig sgrib bsregs/ bde ba skyes par mos/ oṃ ha ha hi hi hriṃ hriṃ hriḥhriḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces dang*/ badz+ra shwa na sa ma ya/ ya ma shwa na sa ma ya/ nā ga shwa na sa ma ya/ kha ra ka shwa na sa ma ya/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ta kṛ ta tsa ti bi tsa ti hu ya hu ya/ hu lu hu lu/ su ru te su ru te swa hā/ ā be sha ya a āḥzhes btags pa yang yang bzla zhing spos dang rol mo'i sgra bya/ yang snying ga'i hūm̐ la sems gtad pas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad dpal rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor gyi sku che chung ma nges pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rgya mtsho chen po la char babs pa ltar sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

sngags brjod cing spos rol bya/ spyi bo'i bla ma la gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'od zer bde ba chen po'i rnam par zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du gyur pa'i ngang la mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de ltar khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ dpal rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid brtan par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis rdo rje spyi bor rgya gram gyi tshul du bzhag cing*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi phyag gi me tog de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phul ba'i mos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ dzñā na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ āḥ zhes pas ma rig pa dang mig dar dus mnyam du bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na srung 'khor gzhal yas khang gi nang du pad+ma zla nyi'i gdan la khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa nas/ thod khrag 'dzin pa'i bar gong ltar brjod nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/ des 'jug pa'i chos song nas dngos gzhi'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon la gus 'dud mdzad pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka dang 'og min nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba re thogs te sku gsung thugs kyi dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shri ye hūm̐/ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ badz+ra ka la sha= rat+na ka la sha= karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan spyi bor bcings nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trāṃ/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i slad du rdo rje g.yas dang*/ pad+ma'i zhags pa g.yon du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod/ shes rab stong nyid rdo rje dang*// snying rje ma chags pad+ma dmar// thabs dang thabs byung zung du 'jug /ye shes thugs kyi dbang thob shog /ces brjod par bya'o// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyang khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ sa gsum gyi bdud thams cad 'dul ba'i dbang thams cad thob par gyur cig ces brjod la me tog gtor/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi cho gas rta mchog rol pa'i skur gyur pa mchod yul du bzung ste mnga' dbul gyi tshul du mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod pas kyang mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs/

shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pas kyang mnga' gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// thams cad bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang skur mchog la bkra shis shog /ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ de dag ni lha sgom pa'i rjes gnang ngo*// gsung bzlas pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i sngags phreng la thim/ de las 'od zer dmar po'i tshogs 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bsdus te thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa dang bcas lha'i nga rgyal brtan po'i ngang nas 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ gong gi sngags rnams lan gsum re rjes zlos byar gzhug byin gyis brlab pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog 'thor ba dang bcas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te spyi bor bzhag pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mchog rol pa yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal rta mchog rol pa yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas rang dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs chad de rang gi spyi bo nas bzhugs/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig la thim pa'i rkyen gyis 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim/ de'ang rim gyis 'od du zhu nas snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ de'ang zhabs kyu khog pa/ khog pa mgo bo/ mgo bo zla tshes/ zla tshes thig le/ thig le nā da la thim/ de'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de las slar rta mchog rol pa'i skur lam gyis ldang mdzod/ de'i mtha' rten du phrin las gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba ni/ gtor ma mgor bzhag la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs shing*// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'byung 'gyur ba'i// gtor ma'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya// badz+ra kro dha la a bhi ṣiñtsa btags pa brjod/ gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i spyi bo'i gtsug tu thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas srung ba'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor hūm̐ yig bkod pa la de 'dra ba du ma byung ste sku lus kyi stod smad thams cad rdo rje'i go chas zhu lugs su gtams pa'i mos pa mdzod/ mdzub mo g.yas su trum̐ las khro bo rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po phyag gnyis kyis mche ba dang sdigs mdzub/ g.yon du oṃ las khro bo mi 'chi thab sbyor dmar po rgya gram dang sdigs mdzub can du bskyed la/ oṃ trum̐/ zhes lte ba/ snying ga ltag pa/ dpral ba/ spyi bo rnams su rim par mdzub mo gnyis bsnol ba reg gnas de dang der khro bo gnyis po zur re zhabs bsnol nas zhal phyir gzigs te srung ba'i las mdzad pa'i thugs ka nas rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud byung bas bsrungs shing brtan par bsam mo// des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ mjug dam tshig khas blang ba sogs spyi ltar byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/

slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la mchod cing bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// snying rje rab khros rta mchog dpal// sgrub thabs rjes gnang 'di brjod dges// 'gro kun rgyal gdon la sogs zhi// pad+ma dbang chen sku thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang nges pa don gyi rdo rje 'chang de nyid kyi phyag bzhes ltar la rje btsun sgrol mgon zhabs kyi gsung dang yang bstun te blo gter dbang pos bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun lam gyi bar chad mtha' dag zhi nas pad+ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang la reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sa dā maṅga la war+dhan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
